prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Two-column layout redesign for adoption certificate screen: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a two-column layout separating certificate details from pet preview visual.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Adopt Your New Desktop Companion", "body": "Your pet certificate is officially ready. Welcome your new companion to your desktop!"}}
1: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive pet naming flow on adoption certificate screen: Introduce an interactive pet name entry input component on the adoption certificate screen before completing adoption.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Name Your Pet & Finalize Adoption", "components": [{"type": "name_input", "label": "Pet Name", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Sign Certificate", "style": "rounded", "action": "next"}]}}
2: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder sign-in screen after adoption certificate screen: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after adoption certificate completion rather than before friend selection.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
3: [sign_in, redesign] List layout redesign for sign-in screen: Rebuild the sign-in screen into a structured list layout clearly detailing authentication options.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "list", "headline": "Sign In to Save Your Pet", "body": "Use your primary account to keep your pet synchronized across desktop sessions."}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Previous account email match hint on sign-in screen: Add a prominent hint advising users to log in with their existing account email to prevent losing previous pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with the same account email previously used to restore existing desktop pets."}}
5: [adoption, hint] Custom pet photo lighting tip on photo upload screen: Add a clear tip on the photo upload screen recommending bright front-facing lighting for custom pet photos.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Ensure bright, clear lighting and a single face focus when uploading custom pet photos."}}
6: [finish, layout] List layout redesign for home intro screen: Rebuild the home intro screen using a list layout to present pet desktop placement status.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "list", "headline": "Your Desktop Companion is Ready", "body": "Your pet will now appear directly on your desktop wallpaper area."}}
7: [sign_in, incentive] Cloud save status badge on sign-in screen: Add a cloud save status badge to the sign-in screen emphasizing pet preservation.
   config: {"sign_in": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Cloud Save Active: Preserves pet data and progress across logins", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [home, wait_info] Desktop overlay loading breakdown on waiting screen: Display explicit setup progress indicators and estimated time remaining during desktop initialization.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "body": "Preparing desktop graphics and animating your companion. Almost ready!"}}
9: [home, notification] Audio ready chime notification toggle on waiting screen: Add an audio ready alert toggle on the waiting screen so users get notified when desktop initialization finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We'll play a gentle audio sound when your desktop pet is ready to launch."}}
